description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-10-26)

### ✨ New Features

* unlock high frame rates in the MIUI Screen Recorder ([6e85695](https://github.com/FluffyDiscord/miui-screen-recorder-fps-unlock/commit/6e85695c1306e7a478501c4e080bf7d02c544de8))

patches.name: Mark tile icon
patches.description: Cuts an "H" into the camera of the Screen Recorder tile icon.

patches.name: Unlock high frame rates
patches.description: Adds 120, 144, 165 and 185 fps, encodes every new screen frame with its own timestamp, and installs the recorder as a separate app next to the stock one.
